market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100; $120 requires +20% rally by end of June (~8 weeks). With Iran ceasefire holding and sanction relief on Iranian oil increasing supply, plus OPEC+ unwinding cuts, supply outlook bearish. A 20% rally over 2 months from a high baseline only with major shock; base rate ~10-15%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran ceasefire collapse and broader Middle East conflict expansion is the only plausible path to $120.
